text:
noah: Quick heads-up — micro kazoo concert in the kitchen at 3:05. BYOK (bring your own kazoo) or a suspiciously musical spoon. :kazoo:
+ riley: i'm in. can my laptop fan be a backup snare? :laughing:
+ tessa: poll: 1) kazoo choir 2) utensil percussion 3) interpretive humming — react with :one: :two: or :three:
+ marc: i'll bring a travel mug with attitude. does this count as a 'team morale' event for calendars? asking for my calendar. :coffee:
+ sam: one-liner warmup: "If my desk plant had stage presence, it'd headline." drop yours.
+ riley: "my stapler only knows the blues."
+ tessa: "mouse pad is the stage manager."
+ marc: "my keyboard moonlights as a triangle."
+ ops-bot: heads-up: fridge cleanout at 4pm today — label any instruments you want returned.
+ noah: five-minute set, applause optional but encouraged. late arrivals earn a solo kazoo. :sparkles:
